jobs.title: School Security Guard
jobs.description:
At Awty, we believe that students learn best, and faculty perform best in a culture of vibrant diversity. Diversity is an essential quality of our school environment; our commitment to learning and the pursuit of excellence can occur only in such a context. It helps us guide our students to become responsible world citizens. Our commitment to learning about and respecting one another’s diversity brings distinct richness to the Awty experience for students, alumni, employees, and parents.

Position Overview

The School Security Guard is responsible for managing and directing traffic flow around school grounds during arrival and dismissal times to ensure the safety of students, staff, and visitors. This position involves coordinating pedestrian and vehicle traffic, enforcing school traffic policies, and working in close collaboration with school administrators, local law enforcement, and community members to maintain safe traffic conditions.

Responsibilities: Essential job functions may include, but are not limited to:

  • Direct and control vehicle and pedestrian traffic during peak times, including student drop-off and pick-up hours.
  • Ensure smooth and safe traffic flow around the school, minimizing congestion and reducing the risk of accidents.
  • Coordinate with other traffic control personnel, school staff, and local authorities to ensure efficient traffic patterns around the school.
  • Ensure that drivers, pedestrians, and cyclists adhere to school traffic regulations and safety rules.
  • Monitor the speed of vehicles near the school, ensuring compliance with speed limits and other traffic laws.
  • Prevent unsafe behaviors such as illegal parking, jaywalking, and other violations in the school zone.
  • Communicate effectively with school staff, parents, and students about traffic procedures and safety protocols.
  • Report any traffic accidents, incidents, or unsafe conditions to the school administration and local law enforcement.
  • Provide assistance and directions to visitors, staff, and parents regarding appropriate parking and traffic routes.
  • Act quickly and efficiently in case of an emergency, including vehicle accidents, medical emergencies, or other urgent situations near the school.
  • Coordinate with emergency responders (police, fire department, or medical teams) as needed in emergency situations.
  • Identify potential traffic issues or congestion points around the school and suggest or implement improvements to traffic patterns.
  • Provide feedback to the school administration and local authorities about traffic-related concerns or areas that require further attention.
  • Maintain accurate records of traffic incidents, accidents, or violations that occur during shifts.
  • Report any issues related to traffic control devices (e.g., traffic lights, signs) that may require attention or repair.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in traffic control, law enforcement, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of traffic laws, pedestrian safety protocols, and school zone regulations.
  • The ability to remain calm and focused in high-pressure or stressful situations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with students, staff, parents, and the community.
  • Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions.
  • Certification in traffic safety or a related field (preferred but not required).
  • Must possess a valid driver's license.


Physical Demands:

  • Ability to walk or move around the school grounds to direct traffic, assist pedestrians, and respond to emergencies.
  • Requires regular physical labor including lifting, carrying, bending, climbing, and operating tools and machinery.
  • Must be capable of lifting a minimum of 50 lbs.
  • Work may be conducted indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.


TO APPLY:

Submit your application through the school's website. All applicants should include a cover letter, current résumé and three professional references (including your most recent direct supervisor).

The Awty International School does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, ethnic or religious beliefs, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law in administration of its educational policies, admissions policies, scholarship and athletic and other school-administered programs or in its employment practices.

    Responsibilities:

    • Continual standing, walking, pushing and pulling.
    • Frequent stooping, bending, kneeling and climbing (ladder), moderate lifting and carrying.
    • Overtime as needed.

jobs.title: Private School Officer
jobs.description:
Security Officer – Private School Campus
Part-Time | $17.00 per Hour
Job Overview
We are seeking a professional, dependable, and highly observant Security Officer to provide safety and security services at a private school campus in Houston, TX 77091. This is a part-time position with strict hours of 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with no exceptions.
The ideal candidate must have prior school officer experience and be capable of maintaining a safe, controlled, and professional environment for students, faculty, staff, and visitors. This role requires strong situational awareness, sound judgment, and the ability to remain actively engaged throughout the shift.
The selected officer must be very good at maintaining ceaseless activity, meaning continuous, constant attentiveness and movement without unnecessary interruption or downtime, especially in monitoring, patrolling, and staying alert to surroundings at all times.
Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct routine and active patrols of school grounds, parking areas, buildings, and assigned zones to deter suspicious activity
  • Maintain a visible and professional security presence throughout the campus
  • Monitor and operate CCTV surveillance systems and other security equipment
  • Control access points and enforce visitor procedures and campus safety policies
  • Respond quickly and appropriately to alarms, emergencies, disturbances, and security incidents
  • Assist with student safety concerns and address conflicts using professional de-escalation techniques
  • Work closely with school administration, staff, and law enforcement when necessary
  • Document incidents, observations, and actions clearly, accurately, and on time
  • Remain engaged in ceaseless activity by consistently patrolling, observing, monitoring, and securing assigned areas during the entire shift
Qualifications / Experience
  • Must possess a valid Texas security license as required for the position
  • Prior school officer experience is required
  • Law enforcement or military background is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of patrol procedures, campus safety, and emergency response
  • Experience with surveillance systems (CCTV) and security reporting
  • Ability to stay calm, alert, and professional in high-pressure situations
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Ability to interact professionally with students, parents, staff, and visitors
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and able to stand and walk for extended periods
  • Must be able to work 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM, Monday through Friday, no exceptions
Work Environment
This position is located at an active school campus in Houston, TX 77091. Officers must be comfortable working around students and maintaining a professional, approachable, and authoritative presence at all times.
Preferred Traits
  • High level of integrity and professionalism
  • Strong observational and decision-making skills
  • Ability to de-escalate tense situations effectively
  • Team-oriented with a strong sense of responsibility
  • Reliable attendance and consistent performance
  • Strong ability to maintain ceaseless activity throughout the shift

jobs.title: Campus Security Guard - Episcopal High School, Houston
jobs.description:
The Campus Security Guard supports a safe, secure, and welcoming school environment for students, faculty, staff, and visitors. This position is responsible for monitoring campus activity, enforcing safety procedures, assisting with emergency response, and supporting daily operations and special events in alignment with the school’s mission and values.

Job Requirements

  • Maintain a safe and secure campus environment during school hours, before and after school activities, and special events.
  • Monitor campus access points, parking lots, event areas, student arrival and dismissal, and visitor activity.
  • Operate and monitor security systems, including cameras, gate access controls, door access controls, and lockdown systems; assist with basic troubleshooting as needed.
  • Provide leadership and direction to off-duty police officers and contracted security personnel when assigned.
  • Assist the Director of Operations and the Director of Safety & Security with scheduling security coverage for special events.
  • Support faculty and staff parking operations, including assignment of spaces and distribution of parking permits and RFID tags.
  • Direct traffic safely and effectively before and after school and during major campus events.
  • Respond calmly and appropriately to emergencies and safety concerns in accordance with established protocols.
  • Accurately document and report all incidents, accidents, and safety concerns using required procedures and forms.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by school leadership.
  • Support and uphold the school’s mission, values, and community standards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required

  • Minimum of four (4) years of security experience.
  • Bachelor’s or Associate Degree
  • Ability to conduct security patrols independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency or willingness to learn security-related technology, including video monitoring, access control, and alarm systems.
  • Ability to complete routine reports and documentation accurately and on time.
  • Ability to safely operate motor vehicles, both electric and gas-powered.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions, procedures, and safety protocols.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, professionalism, and a customer-service mindset when working with students, families, staff, and visitors.
  • Ability to remain calm, make sound judgments, and act effectively in emergency or high-stress situations.
  • Ability to identify potential safety hazards or security risks and report concerns promptly to appropriate personnel.

Working Conditions and Physical Effort

  • Work may involve moderate exposure to outdoor conditions, including heat, cold, and inclement weather.
  • Position requires moderate physical activity, including standing or walking for extended periods and lifting or carrying items up to 50 pounds.

jobs.title: Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Identity Verification
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Identity Verification in KATY, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $15.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon11:00 PM - 07:00 AMThur11:00 PM - 07:00 AMFri11:00 PM - 07:00 AM

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, contractors, and clients at a commercial real estate location by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.
  • Monitor and control access to the property by verifying credentials, documenting visitor and contractor entry, issuing access credentials as authorized, and maintaining visitor logs.
  • Respond to access-control alarms, incidents, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following established escalation and reporting procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of building entrances, common areas, parking areas, and the property perimeter to help identify unauthorized access and unusual activity.
  • Communicate professionally with property management, tenants, and emergency responders, and complete accurate incident reports, daily activity reports, and access-control documentation.

Minimum Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.
